terrain.sampling: Powered descent and coast below 20 km: time step limited to 120 m / inertial speed; powered step <=0.25s, other coast <=2s. DEM grid is 240m, unresolved obstacles excluded.

forward_propagation.method: Coast: independent adaptive DOPRI from actual insertion through DOI. Powered descent: half-step RK4 from actual PDI.

nrho_reference.source: NASA reference epoch initial state, propagated with point-mass Moon and DE440 Earth/Sun tides. No Jacobi/period closure criterion.

transfer_coast.model: Finite constant inertial thrust, variable mass, same dated gravity in burns and coast
transfer_coast.collision_check: Accepted adaptive states with 12 km spherical lunar exclusion margin; not terrain certification.

joint_selection.scope: Best fully validated mission among attempted finite candidates, not proof of global optimum

reference.time: ET/TDB seconds internally; UTC converted using packaged SPICE mapping
reference.dynamics: Lunar point mass + differential Earth/Sun point masses from DE440 for ALL phases; finite constant thrust for departure/insertion/DOI, piecewise acceleration for descent, and integrated mass flow

reference_seed.label: NASA/JSC 2018 reference NRHO state; browser repropagation in simplified DE440 Earth-Moon-Sun model
reference_seed.provenance: Geometric spkezr(-60000, epoch, J2000, NONE, MOON). SPK original origin is Earth, transformed using DE440s. Not a flown/operational ephemeris.
reference_seed.source_force_model: Published reference uses DE430, DE431 GMs, Earth/Moon/Sun/Jupiter and lunar 8x8 gravity plus small stationkeeping impulses.
reference_seed.runtime_force_model: The browser starts only from this state and propagates lunar monopole plus differential Earth/Sun attraction. No source stationkeeping impulses are imported; no exact periodicity is assumed.

joint_search.search_order: All headings, coarse flight-time grid first; remaining grid times second; remaining converged seeds last
